Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting the solicitation and acceptance of campaign contributions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to solicitation and acceptance of campaigncontributions; and reenacting and amending RCW 42.17A.560.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17A.560 and 2006 c 348 s 5 and 2006 c 344 s 31 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) During the period beginning on the thirtieth day before thedate a regular legislative session convenes and continuing through thedate of final adjournment, and during the period beginning on the datea special legislative session convenes and continuing through the datethat session adjourns, no state official or a person employed by oracting on behalf of a state official or state legislator may solicit oraccept contributions to a public office fund, to a candidate orauthorized committee, or to retire a campaign debt. Contributionsreceived through the mail after the thirtieth day before a regularlegislative session may be accepted if the contribution is postmarkedprior to the thirtieth day before the session. (2) The limitations specified in subsection (1) of this sectionalso apply in oddnumbered years to any period the legislature is not p. 1 SB 5988in session if the legislature has not adopted and submitted to thegovernor a biennial operating appropriations act for the ensuing fiscalbiennium. (3) During the period provided for the consideration of bills bythe governor under Article III, section 12 of the state Constitution,the governor and any person employed by or acting on behalf of thegovernor shall not solicit or accept contributions to a public officefund, to a candidate or authorized committee, or to retire a campaigndebt. (4) This section does not apply to activities authorized in RCW43.07.370.
